WITH country_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.wins) as avg_wins
  FROM circuits c
  JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings cs ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_wins) as overall_mean
  FROM country_avg_wins
),
above_overall AS (
  SELECT country, avg_wins
  FROM country_avg_wins
  WHERE avg_wins > (SELECT overall_mean FROM overall_stats)
),
above_group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_wins) as above_group_mean
  FROM above_overall
),
final_countries AS (
  SELECT 
    country,
    avg_wins,
    (SELECT overall_mean FROM overall_stats) as overall_mean,
    (SELECT above_group_mean FROM above_group_stats) as above_group_mean
  FROM above_overall
  WHERE avg_wins > (SELECT above_group_mean FROM above_group_stats)
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_wins) as mean_avg_wins,
  AVG(avg_wins - overall_mean) as mean_exceeds_overall,
  AVG(avg_wins - above_group_mean) as mean_exceeds_above_group
FROM final_countries
